plain_text:
Lowell Hunger & Homelessness Commission           AGENDA – November 04, 2026 
                  12:00PM – 1:30PM 
 
Location: (VIRTUAL) Join Zoom Meeting  
https://us05web.zoom.us/j/86428609035?pwd=PyEhzccv7lQ0wo0FHaPjBYPVfvTnAw.1  
NOTE: THE HUNGER HOMELESS COMMISSION MEETINGS ARE OPEN TO THE PUBLIC. 
 
Meeting Focus: Community Resources & Thanksgiving Support 
Agenda 
 
Item 1: Winter Readiness and Community Resources 
Discussion of winter preparedness, available community resources, and local efforts to support 
individuals and families during the colder months. EOHLC will provide updates on the temporary 
inclement weather policy and Length of Stay (LOS) extensions for Emergency Assistance (EA) 
participants. 
 
Item 2: Thanksgiving Planning and Community Supports 
LASA, Dwelling House of Hope, and Counselor Robinson will share updates on Thanksgiving plans and 
community support efforts. We will also invite other organizations to share information about 
Thanksgiving distributions, events, and available resources. 
 
Item 3: Open Agenda 
Open discussion of emerging community needs, agency updates, partnerships, and opportunities for 
continued coordination. 
 
Item 4: Commission Business 
Commission updates and continued coordination efforts. 
 
For questions regarding this meeting or the Hunger & Homelessness Commission, or to be added or 
removed from the distribution list, please contact: Marie Elianor 
at lowellhungerhomelesscommission@gmail.com
